notes.title: Patch note: Fix problem where achievements are not unlocked
notes.content:
- There are instances where achievements were not unlocked even you completed the requirements ( e.g the perfect run achievement ). We fixed this. And if you earn any achievement already, the next time you boot up the game, the achievement will now rewarded to you.
- Fix problem where if you press A ( or Enter ) to skip a conversation after a dead, it can trigger the last program to run immediately.

notes.title: Bundles released. Cheap price and possible free DLC!
notes.content:
[h1]Celebrating the big update on Jump Step Step[/h1]

Since release, Jump Step Step has been loved for different reasons by different gamers. However, there are still things here and there that do not quite click and our players have voiced their opinions reflecting this.

Gathering ideas and suggestions from different reviews and feedbacks, we are happy to have announced the recent release of our beloved game's updates. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/575710/announcements/detail/2517935604729221309](Read note patch here)[/url]

To celebrate this, [b]we have bundled the game and the DLC into a package that would give you a big discount[/b]. We hope more players would take this opportunities to take a dive and try out the game.

[b]We are also trying to see if the DLC can be free for a period of time[/b], so anyone who has already purchased the main game can keep the DLC forever. This is to show our appreciation for your supports. More news on this later.

I hope you will support and join in with us to celebrate. If you have any questions, leave us a comment or send us a tweet @PhungGames.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27677723/881d6562b3fa0a02d79b66319d17cf1ea4a89821.png[/img]

notes.title: Feedbacks > UPDATES > Improvements > A Better game
notes.content:
You read that right, folks. 
[h1]A huge update was pushed on Steam (and Xbox) a few hours ago.[/h1]
This couldn't have been possible without some great feedback from the community. Thank you all for enduring the frustrations that you faced to give us insightful comments and reviews.

For those who feel the game needed polishing, we heard you! Hopefully the goodies below will make you feel like firing up the game and give it another good whack.

For those who haven't tried the game yet, there are even more reasons now to join this wonderful and brain-teasing adventure.

[b]To help with new players, we added these[/b] [i](check the screenshots at the bottom of this update)[/i]
[list]
[*] Many new tutorial texts that explains new actions.
[*] Add new simple challenges to slowly introduce player to new actions
[*] Tips and tutorial are more visible
[/list]

[b]Improved functionalities for those who can only be satisfied with the best solutions[/b]
[list]
[*] More responsive direct control mode.
[*] Camera is held in position after rotation button is released.
[*] Always show your score in the leaderboard regardless if you have made it to the top 10.
[*] Ability to replay the last challenge. See screenshot for instruction. (Exclusive to STEAM version)
[/list]

[b] Bug Fix[/b]
Fix "Wait Front" action which sometime failed on the "Pond" challenge.

[url=https://youtu.be/khpFv6nuoDo] Updates teaser[/url]

[url=https://twitter.com/PhungGames/status/921768053750165504] Twitter announcement[/url]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27677723/4f678f1aa9bc5c72ba1a014750e94f6db18b4de5.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update with lots of improvements
notes.content:
We have just released a new patch with lots of fixes and features. Below are the changes:

- Add ability to rotate the camera so you can see the puzzle better.
- Fix the game doesn't start, complaining missing vulkan-1.dll
- Much better controller support.
- Revamped, streamlined UI.
- Confirm required when reset savegame.
- And others.

notes.title: Backtrack penalty removed and Ingame leader-board fixed
notes.content:
- Since we didn't realize the game is already hard enough without the life mechanism so we decided to remove this penalty where if you die 3 times, you have to redo your last challenge.

- In game leader-board is now fixed, you can see the full real leader-board for current challenge

- Use can now use "AWSD" keys on keyboard to select actions.
